description: Research a player and his prop the way the Doctor does: his last 5 and last 10 games against his season average and tonight’s line (overs, unders and average margin, hot/cold/steady), his games against tonight’s opponent, the prop against the opponent’s defense (what it allowed in its last 5 finals against the league average per team-game, good/average/bad and rank), both teams’ last 5 results and their head-to-head. league is a LGUE_ id; player is his name (leave it out, with team and opponent, for just both teams’ last 5 and head-to-head); team (or teamId) places him on a roster when the name alone is not enough; opponent defaults to his team’s next game; market ("Points", "Passing Yards", "Shots on Goal", "Strikeouts", "PRA") and line (tonight’s number, e.g. from search_markets) set the over/under counts. Public stats, saved and reused across users. Covers the NBA, WNBA, NFL, college football, NHL, MLB and college basketball; state unavailable says why.
name: get_player_research
title: Research a player prop
